More questions jewellers ask.

What is Jwero Social?

Jwero Social is social media management built for jewellers. It turns signals from your own sales, stock, schemes and the festival calendar into post ideas, makes each post with AI (caption, on-model photo and short video), and publishes it to Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, LinkedIn, YouTube, Threads, X and Google Business in one click or on Autopilot. Comments from six channels and Google reviews from every branch are answered from one screen.

Can AI write jewellery captions and descriptions?

Yes. AI writes captions and hashtags from your catalogue in your shop’s voice. Posts can go out on their own in Autopilot, or wait in an approval queue if you ask for that.

How do I make jewellery posts for Instagram?

Write the post once in the composer, attach photos or video from your library, preview how it looks on each platform, then post it or schedule it. Jwero can also make the post for you from an opportunity in one click.

How do jewellers get sales from Instagram Reels?

A Reel brings comments and messages asking the price; the sale is lost when nobody answers. Reels are made and scheduled from the same screen as other posts; comments come back to one screen and DMs land in One Inbox, where a price question becomes a chat.

How do I get more Google reviews for my jewellery shop?

Ask at the right moment: after a purchase or a completed repair. Jwero connects every Google Business location so reviews appear in one list and your team replies from one screen.

What is the best social media tool for jewellers?

The best social media tool for jewellers tells you what to post from your own stock and sales, makes the post with AI, publishes to every channel and brings comments and Google reviews to one screen. Jwero Social does all of this for Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, LinkedIn, YouTube, Threads, X and Google Business.

What should a jewellery shop post on Instagram?

Post what your business is telling you: a last piece, a new arrival, a festival ahead, a gold rate move, a bestseller or slow stock worth a second look. Jwero Social reads these signals every night and turns them into post ideas.

How often should a jeweller post on social media?

Consistency matters more than volume: a few good posts a week, more around festivals, launches and the wedding season. Jwero Social keeps a calendar filled with ideas so the week is never blank.

What is the best time for a jeweller to post on Instagram?

When your own followers engage most. Jwero Social works it out from your last 30 days and adjusts for paydays, the quiet after a festival and periods such as Pitru Paksha.

Can AI make jewellery posts and reels?

Yes. Jwero Social writes captions and hashtags, puts the piece on a model, styles the photo and turns an image into a short video. Reels publish to Facebook and YouTube Shorts; video posts go to Instagram and the other video channels.

Can social media posts go out automatically?

Yes. In Jwero Social’s Autopilot mode, posts are made and published at the best time on their own. Smart mode prepares drafts for one click, Manual shows the ideas, and an approval queue can sit in front of any of them.

How do I manage comments from all my social media in one place?

Jwero Social brings comments from Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, Threads and X to one screen, matches each commenter to the customer record, and sends DMs to One Inbox.

How do jewellers manage Google reviews for many branches?

Jwero Social brings reviews from every Google Business location into one list, so the team can reply to each from one screen, and posts updates, offers and events to Google Business too.

How do I turn Instagram comments into sales?

Answer price and availability questions quickly and move the buyer to a private chat. In Jwero, your team replies privately from the comments screen and the chat continues in One Inbox, where it can end in a payment.

Which social media channels matter for jewellers?

Instagram and Facebook for discovery, YouTube for video, Pinterest for bridal ideas, Google Business for local search and reviews, and LinkedIn for hiring and B2B. Jwero Social publishes to all of them, plus Threads and X, from one calendar.

How should jewellers plan festival posts?

Plan three weeks ahead of Navratri, Dhanteras, Diwali, Akshaya Tritiya and the wedding season. Jwero Social puts festivals on the opportunity board early, so posts can be made, approved and timed before the rush.

Can I tag products in Instagram posts?

Yes. Jwero Social tags catalogue pieces in Instagram posts and links any post to the products it shows.

How much does social media software for jewellers cost?

Jwero Social starts with a free trial that includes every module; your price is shown inside your account after the trial.

How do I know which posts bring sales?

Jwero Social reports reach and engagement by post and channel, and traces the chats and sales a post started.
